source: Expected outcomes written by hand from each issue's text and recording.
rule: SEEDED FAILURE for tools/check-fixtures.mjs: issue 9257 is also in tuning.json.

entries.bug: Shift angle snapping is lost when an arrow is released over another element
steps: Draw a rectangle
Select the arrow tool
Start an arrow on the rectangle and drag while holding Shift
Release the mouse button while still holding Shift
entries.wrong_result: On release the arrow end jumps to the pointer and the snapped angle is lost
entries.expected_result: The arrow keeps the snapped angle on release, as it does on an empty canvas

steps: Draw several lines
Rotate them
Select them and drag a resize handle
entries.wrong_result: During scaling the rotated lines are transformed as if they were one group
entries.expected_result: Each line scales consistently with its own rotation

steps: Select the draw tool
Press the left button to start drawing
Hold Shift and scroll down, then scroll down again
Release the left button
entries.wrong_result: The stroke scales in the inverted direction
entries.expected_result: Scrolling during drawing behaves consistently and does not invert the stroke

entries.bug: Arrow bindings become invalid after Ctrl+Shift multi-selection inside a group
steps: Create a group of shapes connected by arrows
Select several elements including arrows with Ctrl+Shift
Move the selection
entries.wrong_result: The arrows lose their connection to the elements
entries.expected_result: Arrows stay bound to their elements, as when selecting one by one with Shift

entries.bug: Grouping changes the z-order of the grouped items
steps: Create overlapping shapes with a chosen layer order
Select them and group with Ctrl+G
entries.wrong_result: The grouped items are re-sorted in z-index and the design changes
entries.expected_result: Grouping keeps each item's layer order

entries.bug: The head of an L-shaped elbow arrow shrinks and disappears
steps: Draw an elbow arrow
Drag its segment to bend it into an L shape with the head pointing up
entries.wrong_result: The arrowhead shrinks as the L forms and finally disappears
entries.expected_result: The arrowhead stays visible at its normal size

entries.bug: Arrows detach when a group is moved
steps: Create a group of shapes with arrows bound between them
Move the group around, especially when zoomed out
entries.wrong_result: Some arrows detach and reattach to nothing; it gets worse further zoomed out
entries.expected_result: Bound arrows move with the group and stay attached

entries.bug: Switching tool while drawing an arrow places the arrow instead of cancelling it
steps: Select the arrow tool
Click a start point and a second point
Switch to the selection tool or another tool before finishing
entries.wrong_result: The arrow tool breaks; the unfinished arrow is placed down
entries.expected_result: Switching tool cancels or cleanly finishes the arrow
